en.title: 15 Drawers Rolling Cart, Classroom Organizers
en.summary: A mobile home for materials, stations, and student work
en.usage:
This style of rolling cart is useful when a classroom has plenty of materials but they are hard to find at the moment of instruction. Different drawer sizes and colors make it easy to organize by class, unit, project, or activity type, while the wheels let the cart move between a planning area, teaching space, and student station.

Large drawers hold complete sets
Store worksheets, student projects, printable games, lab sheets, art materials, or work waiting to be reviewed. A different color for each class makes retrieval faster.

Small drawers sort loose supplies
Keep cards, dice, magnets, markers, sticky notes, manipulatives, and exit tickets in a consistent place that students can help maintain.

It can become a learning station
Use the top for a task basket or demonstration materials, then roll the cart to a small group to reduce time spent passing out supplies.

Classroom use tip:
Place heavier paper and supplies in the lower drawers and lighter items near the top. Add word-and-picture labels so students can return materials independently. Lock the wheels before use, and remind students not to climb on the cart or pull out several full drawers at once.

zh.title: 15 格抽屉教室收纳推车
zh.summary: 为材料、学习站和学生作品提供的移动小家
zh.usage:
当教室里材料很多却在上课时不容易找到时，这类收纳推车会很实用。不同大小和颜色的抽屉便于按班级、单元、项目或活动类型整理，脚轮又能让推车在备课区、教学区和学生学习站之间轻松移动。

大抽屉可以整套收纳
存放工作单、学生作品、可打印游戏、实验单、美术材料，或等待批改的作业。为每个班级设定不同颜色，取用会更快。

小抽屉可以分类零散用品
把卡片、骰子、磁贴、马克笔、便利贴、教具和出门条统一放在固定位置，学生也能协助整理维护。

它也能变成一个学习站
用顶部放置任务篮或演示材料，再把推车推到小组旁，减少分发用品所花的时间。

课堂使用小贴士：
把较重的纸张和用品放在下层抽屉，较轻的物品放在上层。贴上图文标签，方便学生独立归还材料。使用前锁好脚轮，并提醒学生不要爬上推车，也不要同时拉出多个装满的抽屉。

title: 听写与即时反馈小白板

en.title: Mini whiteboards
en.summary: Show calculations, diagrams, or short answers for a quick check.
en.usage: Dictate a word or sentence, then have everyone show an answer together. Choose a blank surface for characters, accents, or quick sketches.
en.general: Show calculations, diagrams, or short answers for a quick check.
en.chinese: Dictate Chinese characters, pinyin, or short sentences.

zh.title: 课堂反馈小白板
zh.summary: 写算式、画图或回答简短问题，全班举板检查理解。
zh.usage: 听写词语、汉字或短句，全班同时举板作答，快速查看理解情况。优先选空白板面，方便写不同文字或画图。
zh.general: 写算式、画图或回答简短问题，全班举板检查理解。
zh.chinese: 听写汉字、拼音或中文短句，全班举板作答。

title: 可重复使用的透明可擦写袋

en.title: Reusable dry-erase pockets
en.summary: Reuse worksheets, maps, and practice grids.
en.usage: Slip in your own character grids, sentence frames, or information-gap sheets. Partners can swap sheets and repeat with new vocabulary.
en.general: Reuse worksheets, maps, and practice grids.
en.chinese: Insert character grids or Chinese sentence frames.

zh.title: 可擦写练习袋
zh.summary: 放入练习单、地图或表格，擦掉重练。
zh.usage: 放入自制田字格、句型框架或信息差学习单，擦掉重练；同伴交换材料，就能用新词再做一轮。
zh.general: 放入练习单、地图或表格，擦掉重练。
zh.chinese: 放入田字格或中文句型练习单，练习汉字和替换造句。

en.title: Blank sorting cards
en.summary: Make sorting tasks, matching games, or question cards for any subject.
en.usage: Write your own target-language words. Sort by meaning, match pictures to words, or rearrange cards into sentences. Use colors for sentence roles.
en.general: Make sorting tasks, matching games, or question cards for any subject.
en.chinese: Match characters to pinyin or pictures, then build Chinese sentences.

zh.title: 空白分类卡
zh.summary: 制作各科分类任务、配对游戏或问题卡。
zh.usage: 按教学内容自制词卡，用来分类、图文配对、排句子；用不同颜色区分人物、动作和地点。
zh.general: 制作各科分类任务、配对游戏或问题卡。
zh.chinese: 制作汉字、拼音和图片配对卡，再移动词卡练习中文语序。

en.title: Tabletop pocket chart
en.summary: Display steps, sort examples, or arrange a sequence together.
en.usage: Make word order visible with your own cards. Students move words to build statements, questions, and expanded sentences in the language you teach.
en.general: Display steps, sort examples, or arrange a sequence together.
en.chinese: Move subject, action, and place cards to expand Chinese sentences.

zh.title: 桌面插袋架
zh.summary: 展示步骤、分类例子或共同排列顺序。
zh.usage: 插入自制词卡，让学生移动词语，练习陈述句、问句和扩句；中文、英语及其他语言都可按自己的句型使用。
zh.general: 展示步骤、分类例子或共同排列顺序。
zh.chinese: 移动人物、动作、地点词卡，练习中文语序、问答和扩句。

en.title: Insert-your-own-card dice
en.summary: Insert review questions, movement breaks, or group tasks.
en.usage: Insert pictures or prompts in your target language. Roll for a character, action, or place, then ask partners to make a sentence or continue a story.
en.general: Insert review questions, movement breaks, or group tasks.
en.chinese: Roll Chinese word or picture cards to make sentences and stories.

zh.title: 可换卡片骰子
zh.summary: 放入复习问题、课间动作或小组任务卡，掷骰子选择活动。
zh.usage: 换入图片或目标语言提示卡，掷出人物、动作或地点，让同伴造句或接着讲故事。选可换卡款，方便适配不同语言。
zh.general: 放入复习问题、课间动作或小组任务卡，掷骰子选择活动。
zh.chinese: 放入中文词语或图片卡，掷骰子造句或故事接龙。

en.title: Recordable audio buttons
en.summary: Record short instructions or clues for activity stations. Check recording support before buying.
en.usage: Record a short model phrase for a listening station. Learners listen, respond, and record their own version. Choose recordable buttons, rather than sound-only buzzers.
en.general: Record short instructions or clues for activity stations. Check recording support before buying.
en.chinese: Record Chinese words or model sentences for listening and speaking stations.

zh.title: 可录音按钮
zh.summary: 录下简短指令或线索，帮助学生独立完成学习站任务；购买前确认录音功能和时长。
zh.usage: 录下示范短句，用作听说学习站；学生先听、再回应，也可录下自己的版本。选购时确认支持录音，并核对录音时长。
zh.general: 录下简短指令或线索，帮助学生独立完成学习站任务；购买前确认录音功能和时长。
zh.chinese: 录下中文词语或示范句，设置听音辨词、跟读和口语学习站。

en.title: Storytelling hand puppets
en.summary: Model teamwork, discuss feelings, or explain topics through character dialogue.
en.usage: Give partners two characters for greetings, shopping, or asking for help. Add a simple dialogue frame, then let students change the details.
en.general: Model teamwork, discuss feelings, or explain topics through character dialogue.
en.chinese: Practice greetings, shopping, or asking for help in Chinese.

zh.title: 故事与互动手偶
zh.summary: 通过角色对话示范合作、讨论情绪或讲解课堂主题。
zh.usage: 用两个角色练习问候、购物或求助对话；先提供句型支架，再让学生替换细节，也适合故事复述。
zh.general: 通过角色对话示范合作、讨论情绪或讲解课堂主题。
zh.chinese: 练习中文问候、购物和求助对话，或分角色复述故事。

title: 阅读批注与离堂反馈便利贴

en.title: Sticky notes
en.summary: Collect questions, sort ideas, or gather exit tickets. Reused paper works when sticking is unnecessary.
en.usage: Mark a question, predict the next event, or write one new phrase before leaving. Move notes into groups to compare ideas; use scrap paper when sticking is unnecessary.
en.general: Collect questions, sort ideas, or gather exit tickets. Reused paper works when sticking is unnecessary.
en.chinese: Label objects in Chinese, note new words, or write a Chinese exit sentence.

zh.title: 课堂便利贴
zh.summary: 收集问题、分类想法或进行离堂反馈；不需粘贴时可用废纸代替。
zh.usage: 阅读时写问题、做预测，离堂前写一个新句子；把便签移动分类、比较观点。不需要粘贴的活动也可用废纸代替。
zh.general: 收集问题、分类想法或进行离堂反馈；不需粘贴时可用废纸代替。
zh.chinese: 给物品贴中文标签，阅读时记录生词，或在离堂前写一句中文。
